```{r hill_long to sampledata, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
hill_wide <- hill_long %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample = id) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = sample,
    names_from  = q,           # q should be "h0","h1","h2"
    values_from = value,
    names_glue  = "env_hill_{q}"   # <- gives env_hill_h0/h1/h2
  )

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hill_wide, by = "sample")
```

```{r hill_loop, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

hill_info <- tribble(
  ~q,  ~hill_col,        ~group_col,        ~outname,
  "0", "env_hill_h0",    "env_div_group0",  "q0",
  "1", "env_hill_h1",    "env_div_group1",  "q1",
  "2", "env_hill_h2",    "env_div_group2",  "q2"
)

# Build per-q inputs (metadata w/ tertiles + filtered count matrix)
filtered_inputs <- hill_info %>%
  pmap(function(q, hill_col, group_col, outname) {
    md <- sample_metadata %>%
      mutate(
        !!group_col := ggplot2::cut_number(.data[[hill_col]], 3,
                                           labels = c("Low","Mid","High"))
      ) %>%
      filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c("Low","High"))  # keep only Low/High for 2-group comps

    sel <- md$sample

    # keep only those samples from the genome table, and genomes present ≥1 time
    gc <- genome_counts_filt %>%
      select(genome, any_of(sel)) %>%
      filter(if_any(-genome, ~ .x > 0))

    list(
      q             = q,
      hill_col      = hill_col,
      group_col     = group_col,
      metadata_div  = md,
      genome_counts = gc
    )
  }) %>%
  set_names(hill_info$outname)

#check if there is stuff in the filterd inputs
cat("n filtered_inputs =", length(filtered_inputs), "\n")
purrr::walk(filtered_inputs, ~{
  md <- .x$metadata_div
  cat("q=", .x$q,
      " nLow=", sum(md[[.x$group_col]]=="Low"),
      " nHigh=", sum(md[[.x$group_col]]=="High"),
      " genomes=", nrow(.x$genome_counts),
      "\n", sep = "")
})
```

```{r env_structuralzeros, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- structural zeros ------------------------------------------------------
structural_zeros_list <- purrr::map(filtered_inputs, function(f) {
  md <- f$metadata_div
  gc <- f$genome_counts

  # 1) Low vs High samples
  low_samps  <- md$sample[md[[f$group_col]] == "Low"]
  high_samps <- md$sample[md[[f$group_col]] == "High"]

  # 2) Keep only samples present in gc
  low_samps  <- intersect(low_samps,  colnames(gc))
  high_samps <- intersect(high_samps, colnames(gc))

  # Edge case: if a group has no samples after intersect, return empty tibble
  if (length(low_samps) == 0 || length(high_samps) == 0) {
    return(tibble(genome = character(), present = character(), average = numeric()))
  }

  # 3) Matrix genomes × samples
  mat <- gc %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("genome") %>% as.matrix()

  # 4) “All zero” flags and group means
  all_low_zero  <- rowSums(mat[, low_samps,  drop = FALSE]) == 0
  all_high_zero <- rowSums(mat[, high_samps, drop = FALSE]) == 0
  avg_low       <- rowMeans(mat[, low_samps,  drop = FALSE])
  avg_high      <- rowMeans(mat[, high_samps, drop = FALSE])

  # 5) Label where a genome is structurally absent in one group
  tibble(
    genome   = rownames(mat),
    all_low  = all_low_zero,
    all_high = all_high_zero,
    avg_low  = avg_low,
    avg_high = avg_high
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(all_low | all_high) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      genome,
      present = dplyr::case_when(
        all_low  & !all_high ~ "High",
        all_high & !all_low  ~ "Low",
        TRUE                 ~ NA_character_
      ),
      average = ifelse(present == "High", avg_high, avg_low)
    )
})

```

#### MAG level

```{r env_ancombc, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- build phyloseq per q (keep zeros; no fake pseudocount) --------------
phylo_list <- purrr::imap(filtered_inputs, function(f, name) {
  # sample data
  md_tbl <- f$metadata_div %>%
    dplyr::mutate(!!f$group_col := factor(.data[[f$group_col]], levels = c("Low","High"))) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")

  # counts: integers, zeros allowed (ANCOMBC2 can handle zeros)
  mat <- f$genome_counts %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(-genome, ~ as.integer(round(.x)))) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix()

  otu <- phyloseq::otu_table(mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

  # taxonomy: align to taxa names in otu
  tax <- genome_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(genome %in% phyloseq::taxa_names(otu)) %>%
    dplyr::select(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, genome) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(-genome, ~ dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.), ""))) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    phyloseq::tax_table()

  phyloseq::phyloseq(otu, tax, phyloseq::sample_data(md_tbl))
})

```

```{r env_ancombc_visulasation, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- ANCOMBC2 per q (version-adaptive; prints summary) --------------------
ancom_results <- purrr::imap(phylo_list, function(ps, name) {
  group_col <- filtered_inputs[[name]]$group_col
  fixf      <- paste0("~", group_col)

  # Build args; some versions use tax_level, others taxa_rank
  args <- list(
    data         = ps,
    assay_name   = "counts",
    fix_formula  = fixf,
    struc_zero   = TRUE,        # allow structural-zero modeling
    group        = group_col,   # required when struc_zero=TRUE
    p_adj_method = "BH",
    prv_cut      = 0.05,        # drop ultra-rare features
    lib_cut      = 0,           # keep samples; change if needed
    verbose      = FALSE
  )

  # Add the correct taxonomy arg if present
  fmls <- names(formals(ANCOMBC::ancombc2))
  if ("tax_level" %in% fmls)  args$tax_level  <- NULL
  if ("taxa_rank" %in% fmls)  args$taxa_rank  <- NULL

  message("ANCOMBC2 for q=", name, " (", group_col, ")")
  res <- tryCatch(do.call(ANCOMBC::ancombc2, args),
                  error = function(e) { warning("ANCOMBC2 failed for q=", name, ": ", e$message); NULL })
  if (!is.null(res) && !is.null(res$res$diff_abn)) {
    dt <- res$res$diff_abn
    n_taxa <- nrow(dt)
    pcols  <- grep("^p_", names(dt), value = TRUE)
    n_sig  <- if (length(pcols)) sum(dt[[pcols[1]]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
    message("   tested taxa: ", n_taxa, " | significant (p<0.05): ", n_sig)
  }
  res
})


```

```{r env_ancombc_rand_plot_phy, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=8, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
# --- extract significant features, join taxonomy, and plot ----------------
da_tables <- purrr::imap(ancom_results, function(res, name) {
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$res$diff_abn)) return(NULL)
  dt <- res$res$diff_abn

  # Ensure there is a feature column for joins/labels
  if (!("taxon" %in% names(dt))) {
    dt <- tibble::rownames_to_column(dt, "taxon")
  }

  lfc_col <- grep("^lfc_", names(dt), value = TRUE)[1]
  p_col   <- grep("^p_",   names(dt), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(lfc_col) || is.na(p_col)) return(NULL)

  # Join phylum (optional; for fill aesthetics)
  sig <- dt %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[p_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      genome_metadata %>% dplyr::select(genome, phylum),
      by = c("taxon" = "genome")
    )

  cat("\n### q=", name, ": top DA genomes (p < 0.05)\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(sig)) print(knitr::kable(utils::head(sig, 20))) else cat("(none)\n")

  attr(sig, "lfc_col") <- lfc_col
  attr(sig, "p_col")   <- p_col
  sig
})

# Barplots for significant hits (only if any)
barplots <- purrr::imap(da_tables, function(sig, name) {
  if (is.null(sig) || nrow(sig) == 0) return(NULL)
  lfc_col <- attr(sig, "lfc_col")

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    sig,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[lfc_col]],
                 y = forcats::fct_reorder(taxon, .data[[lfc_col]]),
                 fill = phylum)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x     = "log2 fold-change (High vs Low)",
      y     = "Genome (taxon)",
      title = paste("Differential abundance — Hill", name)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
})

purrr::walk(barplots, ~ if (!is.null(.x)) print(.x))

# Volcano fallback (always shows something even if no sig)
volcanos <- purrr::imap(ancom_results, function(res, name) {
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$res$diff_abn)) return(NULL)
  dt <- res$res$diff_abn
  if (!("taxon" %in% names(dt))) dt <- tibble::rownames_to_column(dt, "taxon")

  lfc_col <- grep("^lfc_", names(dt), value = TRUE)[1]
  p_col   <- grep("^p_",   names(dt), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(lfc_col) || is.na(p_col)) return(NULL)

  df <- dt %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      neglogp = -log10(.data[[p_col]]),
      sig     = .data[[p_col]] < 0.05
    )

  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[lfc_col]], y = neglogp, color = sig)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c04062", `FALSE` = "grey60"),
                                labels = c("ns","p<0.05"), name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "log2 fold-change (High vs Low)",
      y = expression(-log[10](p)),
      title = paste("ANCOMBC2 volcano — Hill", name)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
})

purrr::walk(volcanos, ~ if (!is.null(.x)) print(.x))


```

```{r env_ancom_rand_season, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- optional: ANCOMBC2 with structural zeros ----------------------------
set.seed(1234)

ancom_struczero_results <- purrr::imap(
  phylo_list,
  function(physeq, qname) {
    group_col <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]$group_col
    message("Running ANCOMBC2 (struc_zero=TRUE) for q=", qname,
            " group_col: ", group_col)

    tryCatch({
      ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
        data         = physeq,
        assay_name   = "counts",
        tax_level    = NULL,
        fix_formula  = paste0("~", group_col),
        rand_formula = "~1",
        p_adj_method = "holm",
        pseudo_sens  = TRUE,
        prv_cut      = 0,
        lib_cut      = 0,
        s0_perc      = 0.05,
        group        = group_col,
        struc_zero   = TRUE,
        neg_lb       = FALSE,
        alpha        = 0.05,
        n_cl         = 2,
        verbose      = TRUE,
        global       = FALSE,
        pairwise     = FALSE,
        dunnet       = FALSE,
        trend        = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("ANCOMBC2 (struc_zero) failed for ", qname, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
  }
)
```

```{r env_ancom_rand1, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- optional: build cleaned tables for struc_zero run --------------------
# (requires the same color TSV if you want custom phylum colors)
ancom_struczero_tables <- purrr::imap(
  ancom_struczero_results,
  function(ancom, qname) {
    if (is.null(ancom)) return(NULL)

    taxonomy <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(phylo_list[[qname]])) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(c(order, phylum, family, genus, species),
                           ~ stringr::str_replace(as.character(.), "[dpcofgs]__", "")))

    tab <- ancom$res$diff_abn
    if (is.null(tab)) return(NULL)

    lfc_col <- grep("^lfc_", names(tab), value = TRUE)[1]
    p_col   <- grep("^p_",   names(tab), value = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.na(lfc_col) || is.na(p_col)) return(NULL)

    ancom_tab <- tab %>%
      dplyr::select(taxon, !!rlang::sym(lfc_col), !!rlang::sym(p_col)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data[[p_col]]) %>%
      merge(taxonomy, by = "taxon") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.data[[lfc_col]])

    attr(ancom_tab, "lfc_col") <- lfc_col
    attr(ancom_tab, "p_col")   <- p_col
    ancom_tab
  }
)
```
